adapter_policy: Takes a commit of the project journal back or makes it again on the connection of the piece that owns the rows (user 2026-11-25: Undo and Redo from the journal): each row put back as it was before (or after) the commit, in the order that leaves no stale row. A row changed since by another edit is never overwritten: the step is refused and the caller transaction takes nothing. Columns the piece calls loose (selection, recording, stamps) are neither checked nor put back. It writes only through the connection it is given.
